LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliNormal.label: Zhaoli's daily wear
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliNormal.description: A violet-black outfit Zhaoli habitually wears. Its outer hem is darkened, while the inner layer carries fine violet-white patterns that echo Severance's hilt and Zhaoli's karmic arts.
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliHood.label: Zhaoli's hood
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliHood.description: A dark hood Zhaoli wears when traveling outside. Violet patterns line its edge, and it can cover the halo above her head, making her less conspicuous on the ground.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.label: Severance
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.description: Zhaoli's melee armament, with the built-in ability Severing Slash. Its blade is plain white and its hilt is wrapped in violet-black. When swung, it leaves a brief violet-white arc, suited for clearing enemies ahead with a precise horizontal cut.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.tools.0.label: Severance
